SELECT * INTO [d360].[HASH_LOG_TBL_BU_20240116] FROM [d360].[HASH_LOG_TBL]

SELECT * FROM [d360].[HASH_LOG_TBL] WHERE FILE_NAME LIKE '%CRM%' and  source <> target and FILE_NAME = 'CBC01_CRM_CUSTOMER_009_20230109.csv'
order by 1

DELETE FROM [d360].[HASH_LOG_TBL] WHERE FILE_NAME LIKE '%CRM%'

exec [d360].[SP_hash_log_CRM]

WITH CTE1 
AS(
SELECT convert(NUMERIC(25,5),COUNT(*)) COUNT_tgt
, isnull(sum(convert(NUMERIC(25,5),AMOUNT1)),0) AMOUNT1_tgt
, isnull(sum(convert(NUMERIC(25,5),AMOUNT2)),0) AMOUNT2_tgt
, FILE_NAME, INSERT_DTTM 
FROM d360.STG_CRM_CUSTOMER WHERE H = 'D' and FILE_NAME = 'CBC01_CRM_CUSTOMER_009_20230109.csv' and AMOUNT2 is not null
GROUP BY FILE_NAME, INSERT_DTTM
)
,
CTE2 AS (
SELECT REPLACE(H,'F-','') COUNT_src
, AMOUNT1 AMOUNT1_src
, AMOUNT2 AMOUNT2_src

, FILE_NAME, INSERT_DTTM FROM d360.STG_CRM_CUSTOMER WHERE H <> 'D' order by 4
)
,
CTE12 as (
SELECT COUNT_SRC, COUNT_TGT
, AMOUNT1_tgt
, AMOUNT2_tgt
, AMOUNT1_src
, AMOUNT2_src

, A.FILE_NAME, A.INSERT_DTTM, CONVERT(DATE,(left(right(A.FILE_NAME, 12),8))) DATE FROM CTE1 A
JOIN CTE2 B ON A.FILE_NAME = B.FILE_NAME AND A.INSERT_DTTM = B.INSERT_DTTM
)


INSERT INTO [d360].[HASH_LOG_TBL]
SELECT 
FILE_NAME
,DATE
,insert_dttm
,REPLACE(METRICS,'_SRC','') METRICS
,SRC
,TGT 

FROM
(
SELECT 
 CAST(COUNT_SRC AS NUMERIC(25,5)) COUNT_SRC
,CAST(COUNT_TGT AS NUMERIC(25,5)) COUNT_TGT
,CAST(AMOUNT1_tgt AS NUMERIC(25,5)) AMOUNT1_tgt
,CAST(AMOUNT2_tgt AS NUMERIC(25,5)) AMOUNT2_tgt
,CAST(AMOUNT1_src AS NUMERIC(25,5)) AMOUNT1_src
,CAST(AMOUNT2_src AS NUMERIC(25,5)) AMOUNT2_src
,FILE_NAME
,INSERT_DTTM
,[DATE]
FROM CTE12
) pvt

UNPIVOT
(
SRC FOR METRICS IN (COUNT_SRC
, AMOUNT1_src
, AMOUNT2_src
)
) pvt1

UNPIVOT
(
TGT For METRICS2 IN (COUNT_TGT
, AMOUNT1_tgt
, AMOUNT2_tgt
)
) pvt2
 
WHERE REPLACE(METRICS,'_SRC','') = REPLACE(METRICS2,'_TGT','');
